function_role: Performs mathematical operations on floating-point values—involving scaling, rounding via truncation/ftol, and clamping—to compute a composite integer index or table lookup coordinate based on bounds constraints (limiting values between 0 and 23).

callsite_summaries.0x0041A160: Called twice within the function to convert intermediate floating-point calculation results in the x87 FPU stack into integer values (via __ftol2_sse) so they can be clamped and combined into a final coordinate/index returned in eax.
